issue: rawTranscript is trimmed before filtering, altering leading/trailing whitespace when hallucination filter is disabled
resolution: Gated trimming on hallucinationFilterEnabled: raw provider transcript is preserved verbatim when filter is disabled.

issue: Disabled items included in keyboard navigation
resolution: Filtered out disabled items (item.disabled) from actionableIndices in handleKeyDown.

issue: setInstruction("") executes after unmount if user cancels during edit
Background update poll runs in all windows including popouts
resolution: Added if (!isMainWindow) return; guard to useIntervalAsync check for updater.

issue: Silence early return hardcodes transcriptionMode: "api" instead of using instance mode

issue: Silent leading chunks return null metadata, losing provider metadata on multi-chunk audio
resolution: Extracted metadata from first non-null chunk result via results.find(r => r.metadata !== null)?.metadata.
